sentences.en: Our Father who art in heaven, hallowed be your name.
sentences.zh: 我们的天父，在天上，愿你的名受崇敬。

sentences.en: "You're another" is a hallowed rejoinder to playground taunts.
sentences.zh: "你另寻其乐"是应对操场戏弄的经典回应。

sentences.en: She said, / and to his hallowed seat the aged monarch led.
sentences.zh: 她说，并引导这位年迈的君主走向他神圣的位置。
